name: aspect-ratio
title: Aspect Ratio
summary: A box that keeps its width-to-height ratio for images, video and embeds.
description: A box that keeps a width-to-height ratio as its width changes: images, video, maps and embeds. Its width comes from its container; its height follows the ratio and never grows with its content. A direct child (an image, a video, an iframe or any element) fills it; media cover it. No look of its own: the caller rounds or frames it.

anatomy.description: aspect-ratio from --fndn-aspect-ratio; full width of its container, clips what overflows. Its direct children fill it (img, video and iframe with object-fit: cover).

ratio.description: Width divided by height (16 / 9 by default; 1 is a square, 0.75 a portrait 3:4). A value that is not a positive number falls back to 16 / 9.

slots.default: The content that fills the box.

notes: No role: the box is layout only. Give its image an alt text or its iframe a title.
